title: ops content publish reports failure on a 30 second client timeout while the page-building Lambda is still writing pages
description: papyrus ops content publish prints 'FAILED to project the page: the data is published but the page is not live (The read operation timed out)' when the page-build step outlasts the CLI GraphQL timeout (default 30 s, PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS). The content-actions Lambda runs up to about 75 s and completes the write anyway, so the report is wrong and operators retry. Fix: a longer default for the projection call, or return a job id and poll; report 'still running' distinctly from 'failed'. Seen on machines-on-machines 2026-11-08 across about 20 publishes.
